Summary of the comps
7 closed comps plus 2 off-market (no sold date) and 3 active/pending.
Closed comps: last list/sold prices from $489,000 to $1,195,000; median $241/sf (subject asks $250/sf).
Price-per-sq-ft reference (unadjusted): $241 × 3,396 sq ft = $818,436. A simple price-per-sq-ft reference from the closed comps, with no adjustments for lot, age, condition or features.
  • Closed Bellville-area homes on 2.5 to 7 acres have last list prices from about $489,000 to $899,990 over the past year; only one (2051 Hillview Rd at $899,990) listed above this home's $850,000 ask, and that one is a smaller home on 4.4 acres.
  • $850,000 is about $250/sf for 3,396 sf. The closed comps' last list prices run roughly $183 to $456/sf (median $241/sf); the $456/sf figure is the pool home on Ueckert Rd.
  • Three nearby active homes list between $695,000 and $850,250 on 1 to 1.5 acres, so buyers also have lower-priced alternatives with smaller lots.
Read this first: Texas does not disclose sale prices. Unless a card says “Last sold price (Redfin)”, the price shown for each comp is its last list price, not what it sold for. Actual sale prices and concessions may be lower or higher. Last list prices are not sale prices. Several comps closed more than six months ago, and none of these Bellville homes has the subject's exact mix of size, lot and age.

Method and limits. Comps come from real listing portals (links on each card), checked on Nov 4, 2026 (America/Denver).
